name: true polymorph
lore:
# On the Art of True Polymorph

To cast *True Polymorph* is to hold the clay of creation in mortal hands. Visually, the spell manifests as a shimmering, auric lattice that wraps the target, momentarily rendering them translucent as their fundamental geometry dissolves. It is a terrifying beauty—the sight of reality being erased and rewritten in the same heartbeat.

The practitioner feels the Weave not as a thread, but as a dense, molten tide. Shaping this magic requires the will of a titan; it feels like pulling heavy silk through a needle's eye, a viscous tension that threatens to snap the caster’s mind if their concentration wavers for even a second.

Legend attributes its discovery to Archmage Lyraen the Malleable. It is said he spent forty years staring at a single river pebble until he perceived the "dormant dragon" within its stillness. By whispering the pebble's secret name, he birthed the first permanent transmutation, proving to the cosmos that form is merely a suggestion, and the soul is the only true constant.
